name: Dipna Pharmachem Limited
summary: Dipna Pharmachem Ltd. specializes in the procurement, distribution, and sale of raw materials and chemical formulations for the pharmaceutical industry. Its product portfolio includes critical components such as active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and excipients. Additionally, the company generates revenue by facilitating chemical sales through a commission-based model. Founded on July 19, 2011, the firm's headquarters are located in Ahmedabad, India.
